dedupe_keys.name: pvdata annotated photovoltaic imagery and vectors

description: The global photovoltaic mapping research team publishes PVdata, annotated imagery and vector data supporting its solar-panel mapping study. The deposit covers georeferenced Google Earth TIFF images, training and validation images with labels, and vector counterparts indexed to the annual global map tiles. Zenodo offers the archives free under CC BY 4.0. They can support image-classification calibration when building photovoltaic asset inventories for infrastructure simulations, complementing data-global-power-plant-database. A caveat is that the deposit licence does not independently resolve the original imagery provider's rights. The documentation also describes random training and validation partitioning, which needs attention when assessing spatial transfer or leakage. Exact sample counts, internal vector format and class balance were not verified. Only metadata and archive filenames were inspected.
